answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 20672 Country: India Title: What is the meaning of SIKANDER....Can i name my son this name..? is this name is lawful or unlawful... halal or haraam...pls tell me... Question: Assalamualikum.What is the meaning of SIKANDER....Can i name my son this name..? is this name is lawful or unlawful... halal or haraam...pls tell me... Answer ID: 20672 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 475/393/B=1431) Sikandar means: one who holds high position in rank, wealth and honour. It has been the name of a king. You can keep this name. It is correct. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
